gotchas: No guest checkout: signed out, "Continue to payment" on /en/checkout opens a Log in iframe from login.gog.com. Sign in first.

Sign-in is in an iframe (iframe[src*="login.gog.com"]) opened by the header SIGN IN button: #login_username, #login_password. Use frame-aware fills and press Enter on #login_password in that frame (a top-level click on "Log in now" times out). When login.gog.com already knows the account only the password field shows.
A cookie banner (Reject all) and an age gate on many product pages: press Enter on `.age-gate button`. Press Enter on the add-to-cart button rather than clicking it.

Payment is Adyen secured fields (split iframes, not Stripe): three separate iframes for number, expiry (MM/YY) and security code, addressed by title. Fill expiry first, then number and CVC back to back. No cardholder name field was shown.
Verified 2026-10-06 through the proxy (US tunnel) with the public test card under a verification-only key: all three fields filled, no Adyen field error. Stopped before "Checkout order now".
